GBP.reason: The official historical nominal government zero-coupon curve archive is revisionable and the currently available archive does not provide the revision-vintage provenance required to prove what the model could have known at each historical decision date. Current revised history is not accepted as point-in-time evidence.
GBP.allowed_next_step: Resume only if official revision-vintage or archived historical snapshots with sufficient provenance become available.

NZD.source: B2 Wholesale interest rates – government bond close
NZD.reason: The official RBNZ B2 page/XLSX has been manually verified for current same-basis 2Y/10Y data, but the canonical official XLSX returns HTTP 403 to GitHub-hosted runners. A deterministic official historical replay cannot currently be materialized in CI without bypassing the official-source requirement.
NZD.allowed_next_step: Resume when official RBNZ historical transport is accessible from the controlled runner or an official archival endpoint with equivalent provenance is available.

CHF.reason: The previously validated official SNB spot-rate export currently returns metadata without observations. Mixing a separately published current 10Y with another 2Y source would violate the same-basis contract.
CHF.allowed_next_step: Resume when an official same-basis 2Y/10Y historical export is available again.
